# Ultramaster KR-106 DSP (vendored)

The DSP headers of Ultramaster KR-106, a Juno-6/60/106 emulation, copied unmodified from
https://github.com/kayrockscreenprinting/ultramaster_kr106 at commit
bc15caee5843ab238a25d0969e68d57db2b1615f (7 May 2026).

Licence: GNU GPL v3 (see LICENSE); authors in AUTHORS. 8track uses the voice engine
(KR106_DSP.h) for its Juno-style synth and the BBD chorus (KR106Chorus.h) for the Juno modes
of its Chorus effect.
